segments.sn7.17:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe.
segments.sn7.17:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena navakammikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe kammantaṃ kārāpeti.
segments.sn7.17:1.3: Addasā kho navakammikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ aññatarasmiṃ sālarukkhamūle nisinnaṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
segments.sn7.17:1.5: “ahaṃ kho imasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe kammantaṃ kārāpento ramāmi.
segments.sn7.17:1.6: Ayaṃ samaṇo gotamo kiṃ kārāpento ramatī”ti?
segments.sn7.17:1.7: Atha kho navakammikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn7.17:2.1: “Ke nu kammantā karīyanti, bhikkhu sālavane tava;
segments.sn7.17:4.1: Evaṃ vutte, navakammikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn7.17:4.2: “abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama … pe … upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan”ti.

lines: Sattame navakammikabhāradvājoti so kira araññe rukkhaṃ chindāpetvā tattheva pāsādakūṭāgārādīni yojetvā nagaraṃ āharitvā vikkiṇāti, iti navakammaṃ nissāya jīvatīti navakammiko, gottena bhāradvājoti navakammikabhāradvājo.
Disvānassa etadahosīti chabbaṇṇarasmiyo vissajjetvā nisinnaṃ bhagavantaṃ disvāna assa etaṃ ahosi.
Aratiṃ vippahāyāti pantasenāsanesu ceva bhāvanāya ca ukkaṇṭhitaṃ jahitvā.
Vanakamme niyutto, kiriyamānena vanakammaṃ etassa atthīti vanakammiko.
Na me vanasmiṃ karaṇīyamatthi yathā,“brāhmaṇa, tuyhan”ti adhippāyo.
Itaraṃ pana yaṃ mahākilesavanaṃ, taṃ maggañāṇapharasunā samādhimayasilāyaṃ sunisitena sabbaso ucchinnamūlaṃ, tato eva nibbanatho nikkilesagahano.
